improvedVsOld: The new text is clearly better than the old. It removes calques (« camp », « check-lists », « Calculettes », « Votre prochain lieu est quelque part dehors », « la table de préparation ») and lines up the app labels with the glossary (« J’ai aimé », « Favoris », « Envie de visiter », « Visité », « Épingles », « tous les lieux enregistrés »). It also replaces most « hors connexion » wording with « lisibles sans réseau / intégrés à l’app », adds the 11 l / 9 l tank-assumption sentence that the old calculatorNote dropped, and fixes ui.fuelTitle, which used to repeat the eyebrow. Glossary terms (aires de vidange, aires de pique-nique, freedom camping glossed in meta, iwi et hapū glossed) and vous-register imperatives are used consistently. The only regressions are ui.driveTitle (the old version was better) and the double non-breaking spaces in saveText and faq5a.
criticalIssues: The French privacy policy has no 'Website analytics' section. English on origin/main has 7 sections, including 4 paragraphs on GA4: the _ga and _ga_* cookies, 13-month expiry, consent for EEA/UK/CH visitors and 14-month retention. French has only 6 sections. app components/localized-site.tsx renders the French sections array as is, so French and EEA visitors get no analytics or cookie disclosure while GA4 runs. The branch was cut before the GA4 commit 8e4aa1e. Rebase it on main, translate pages.privacy.sections[4] (Website analytics, 4 paragraphs) and update pages.privacy.effective to 19 octobre 2026 before merging. Comparing by JSON path is currently misaligned for privacy sections[4] and [5].

No em dashes, no offline-map claims, no wrong script or characters, and no English left untranslated beyond protected or glossary terms. Brand names, NZD, numbers (6 500, 2 000, 11 l / 9 l) and Māori diacritics (māori, hapū) are intact. Minor note: ui.metaSupportDescription keeps « données hors connexion », which is not a map claim but is inconsistent with « sans réseau » everywhere else; « données consultables sans réseau » would be better.
